name: @beamdesk/server
description: BeamDesk signaling server: device registry, connection relay, TURN credentials and the web app.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --legal-comments=none "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __bdRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __bdRequire(import.meta.url);"
